purpose: Front, close ring-stacking pair for slide 3, replacing the overhead videos at user request.
camera: bottom_camera (physical front view, despite the dataset camera name)

crop.note: Same 520×390 close framing as the prior manuscript images, shifted upward 14 pixels from y=30 to keep the peg tip visible. No perspective transformation or object retouching.

twin.rendering: For each physical action-sample timestamp, select the nearest saved state, assign qpos/qvel/time, call mj_forward and renderer.update_scene(camera=bottom_camera), then render and crop. No mj_step call, motion synthesis or new physics simulation.

real.processing: Fixed spatial crop only; physical timing is unchanged.

alignment.note: Camera frame i corresponds to action sample i; saved twin poses selected using that action timestamp. Existing shared-clock playback keeps the two video elements synchronized.

interpretation: Recorded physical task trajectory and render of saved twin states illustrate physical grounding. Camera extrinsics remain reconstructed estimates. These clips do not show a newly measured recovery outcome and are not quantitative fidelity validation.
